blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: A comprehensive glossary provides quick reference to technical definitions vital for both prelims and mains examinations.
Clear conceptual understanding of terminologies prevents confusion with close distractors in multiple-choice questions.
Key economic terms such as Repo Rate, Inflation, and GDP form the foundation for current affairs comprehension.
Constitutional concepts like Quorum, Writs, and Ordinances are repeatedly tested across major competitive exams.
